turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Hi Leo! Happy Saturday. How is your weekend starting off in Austin?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Morning! It's starting off pretty well. I just walked back from the cafe with an oat milk latte to get me energized.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: An oat milk latte sounds like the perfect way to start a Saturday. Is it already pretty hot outside today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh, definitely. It's already baking out there, so I'm just wearing a fitted t-shirt and shorts to stay cool indoors.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Makes sense for an August day in Texas! Speaking of plans, how are things going with your sister Ana's wedding prep? November will be here before we know it.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: It really will! She's finalizing the catering right now. I've been helping her look at some vegetarian options so I'll actually have something good to eat at the reception.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That's nice of you to help out, and it's always great when there are solid vegetarian dishes at weddings. Are you cooking much today yourself?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A little bit. For lunch, I'm putting together a homemade salad with some fresh greens and veggies I bought.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Nice and light, perfect for a hot day. Do you have any plans to head out to the climbing gym later, or is today more of a rest day?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I think I might go climbing for a bit this afternoon. Sam is busy doing some grocery shopping, so I've got the place to myself to practice guitar first.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds like a very relaxing Saturday. What have you been working on on the guitar lately?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Just trying to perfect a fingerpicking song I've been practicing. Well, I'm going to eat my lunch and get to it. Talk to you later!
